description: The plot illustrates the loss of two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, during training and validation, with the x-axis labeled "Step" and ranging from 0 to 60,000 in intervals of 10,000, on a linear scale, and the y-axis labeled "Loss" and ranging from 2 × 10^0 to 1.2 × 10^1 in intervals of 1 × 10^0, on a linear scale. The plot displays four lines: Ex1 Loss in blue with a solid line, starting at approximately 3.5 and decreasing to around 1.9; Ex2 Loss in green with a solid line, starting at around 3.5 and decreasing to approximately 2.2; Ex1 Validation Loss in blue with a dashed line, starting at around 5 and decreasing to approximately 3.1; and Ex2 Validation Loss in green with a dashed line, starting at around 11 and decreasing to approximately 3.4. The Ex1 Loss and Ex2 Loss lines both decrease rapidly between 0 and 10,000 steps, with Ex1 Loss continuing to decrease gradually until around 20,000 steps, while Ex2 Loss decreases more slowly until around 20,000 steps. The Ex1 Validation Loss and Ex2 Validation Loss lines also decrease rapidly between 0 and 10,000 steps, with Ex1 Validation Loss continuing to decrease gradually until around 20,000 steps, and Ex2 Validation Loss decreasing more slowly until around 20,000 steps, before stabilizing.
